d: Wavy, chestnut brown hair is styled in a voluminous, messy mop with short bangs and a longer nape. Narrow, dark brown eyes peer through silver-rimmed glasses with a gentle expression on a face appearing to be in the late teens or early twenties. A lean build is dressed in a white short-sleeved button-up shirt with a grey-trimmed V-neck sweater vest, a black and white checkered tie, and brown pleated trousers with rolled cuffs. Signature accessories include black fingerless gloves, a brown utility belt holding several pouches, a leather holster, and dark grey dress shoes.
